parameters.name: identityTarget
parameters.description: The social identity target, e.g. "dingtalk". Must be used together with `identityUserId`. Cannot be combined with other user search filters such as `search.*`, `excludeRoleId`, or `excludeOrganizationId`.

parameters.name: identityUserId
parameters.description: The external user identifier stored in the social identity. Must be used together with `identityTarget`. Cannot be combined with other user search filters such as `search.*`, `excludeRoleId`, or `excludeOrganizationId`.

200.description: An array of users that match the given criteria. When looking up by social identity (`identityTarget` + `identityUserId`), the array contains at most one user, or is empty when no linked user is found.

400.description: The request is invalid. For example, only one of `identityTarget` / `identityUserId` is provided, or identity lookup is combined with other user search filters.

get.description:
Get users with filters and pagination.

Logto provides a very flexible way to query users. You can filter users by almost any fields with multiple modes. To learn more about the query syntax, please refer to [Advanced user search](https://docs.logto.io/docs/recipes/manage-users/advanced-user-search/).

You can also look up a user by a linked social identity using `identityTarget` and `identityUserId` together. When both are provided, other search filters cannot be used in the same request.
